newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus has 220,000 digital subscribers.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus has 220,000 digital subscribers.

text.p: French pay-television group Canal Plus said on Thursday it had 220,000 subscribers to its CanalSatellite digital television service at the end of 1996.
It said in a statement "the results from the first eight months of operation have been very positive, with better than expected subscription growth."
In November 1996, Canal Plus finance director Laurent Perpere said, "We forecast a figure of 200,000 at the end of the year, maybe 250,000."
Canal Plus said a "record" 41,000 people had subscribed to CanalSatellite in December.
CanalSatellite, the first European digital television operation, was launched on April 27, 1996.
